overrides.tagline: Curated collection of runnable Azure AI Foundry samples covering agents, evaluation, RAG, and model deployment

reason: Auto-pipeline classified this as a single application but the repo is a docs-embedded sample collection spanning agents, eval, RAG, and model-deployment scenarios. Multi-category classification + sample-collection tag are needed so the website can render it correctly (collection-style card, not single-fruit card). Froot layer 'F' (Foundations) because the samples teach the underlying Azure AI Foundry primitives rather than implementing a higher-layer reasoning or orchestration pattern.
